- ordering/identity fail-closed
- missing/corrupt evidence fail-closed

- no promotion side effect
- no trading/execution side effect.

- REUSE_BEFORE_NEW ohne Re-Architecture/Parallel-Authority.
- keine historische Rekonstruktion ohne CURRENT Dependency.
